title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-29
content:
Morning plan / context:
- Focus: finalize PRD edits for streaming fallback behavior, unblock eng on canary rollout + production runbook.
- Two blockers: SRE needs clarity on kcache eviction for long-running chat sessions; infra needs final quantization profile for 8-bit path.

TODAY top-level todos:
1) PRD edits (30-60m)
   - Address review comments from Alex (latency SLO wording) + add section for graceful fallback to smaller model variant.
   - Add example flow for user-visible partial responses when fallback occurs.
   - Update acceptance criteria: latency metric + qualitative prompt set checks.
2) Follow-ups (async)
   - Ping SRE (Ravi) for kcache rollout timeline and hotfix plan (Jira REDWOOD-2148).
   - Confirm with infra about quantization profile (8-bit) delivery by EOD.
   - Email Solutions Eng to confirm customer-facing messaging for Dedicated customers (privacy/keys note).
3) Launch checklist items to close before canary:
   - [ ] Canary config in console enabled and flagged (console route+model pairing)
   - [ ] Alerting: token-level cost + latency SLOs wired to prod-alerting channel
   - [ ] Rollback plan documented in Confluence (prod/hosted-api/rollout-plan)
   - [ ] Smoke tests: streaming + function calling testcases green
   - [ ] Eval: run small prompt-set, compare outputs between baseline and fallback variant, log differences
4) Meetings
   - 10:30am sync w/eng (runtime) — bring the PRD doc link and the example flows
   - 1:00pm SRE deep-dive (confirm cache eviction behavior)
   - 3:30pm Launch readiness quick sync (PM + ENG + SRE + Solutions)

Notes from this morning's review:
- Alex: wording on "graceful degradation" too vague; suggested adding exact user-visible examples and a committed maximum latency for fallback.
- Ravi: wants explicit guarantee that KV cache eviction won't leak across sessions; I need to add a short section about per-tenant cache scoping.
- Infra: quant profile OK in principle but wants a final perf run with seq_len=2048 and batch mix to sign off.

Draft PRD changes to make (copy into doc):
- Section: "Fallback & Degradation" -> add subsections:
   * Trigger conditions (queue depth, soft latency threshold, model OOM)
   * Fallback path: route to smaller model variant (model-id + rationale)
   * User-visible behavior: partial streamed response + "continuing on fallback" banner in SDK
   * Acceptance tests: latency spike simulation + output-quality regression <5% on curated eval set
- Section: "Observability" -> add token-level cost sample queries + example Grafana panels to attach
- Section: "Rollback" -> steps to flip route back, invalidate caches, and TTL behavior to monitor

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we need to surface fallback events in the audit logs (security asks for this)?
- Should Solutions Eng get a pre-recorded demo or a runbook only? (leaning runbook + short recorded walkthrough)
- Do we hard-block Dedicated customers from fallback path? (security/privacy concern)

Quick TODOs (notes to self):
- After eng sync: update PRD and mark as in_review, assign to Alex for final wording check.
- Create a small eval run: 200 prompts across 4 categories (chat, summarization, code, long context). Put results in /evals/canary-prep-2026-03-29.csv (linked_artifact once done).
- Update Confluence rollout-plan with the explicit rollback steps and attach the smoke test checklist.

Meeting snippets (capture):
- Eng sync: agreed to add feature flag for fallback routing; runtime will implement flag and a health-check endpoint. Need to add health-check URL to PRD.
- SRE: suggested conservative default for kcache eviction window = 30m per-session; will test for memory pressure.

End-of-day acceptance criteria (my sign-off):
- PRD in_review with all changes (esp fallback wording)
- Canary config in console staged and health-check endpoint returning OK
- Eval run started and infra perf run scheduled
- All stakeholders (Eng, SRE, Solutions) have acked the launch checklist

Random notes / brain dump:
- Consider adding a "graceful-fallback" telemetry event with fields: customer_id, route_id, original_model, fallback_model, latency_before, latency_after, reason_code. Good for post-mortem + cost accounting.
- If we expose "fallback" to customers via SDK, include opt-out flag for Dedicated customers.

Links to follow-up:
- Confluence rollout: prod/hosted-api/rollout-plan
- Jira: REDWOOD-2148 (kcache eviction)
- PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/342 (canary config changes)

Done-ish: keep moving. If blockers persist after afternoon sync, we may delay canary by 24h rather than risk a sloppy rollout.

---
Quick sign-off checklist (tick as I go):
[ ] PRD edits pushed
[ ] SRE ack on kcache
[ ] Infra quant perf run scheduled
[ ] Console canary staged
[ ] Eval started
summary: PM scratchpad capturing PRD edits, follow-ups with SRE/infra, and launch checklist for canary rollout of streaming fallback behavior.
